subtitle: Lesson 3 · Panels of (date, ticker) data

code:
dates = pd.date_range("2025-01-02",
                       periods=3, freq="B")
idx = pd.MultiIndex.from_product(
    [dates, ["AAPL", "MSFT"]],
    names=["date", "ticker"])
panel = pd.DataFrame({"ret": ...}, index=idx)
caption: from_product builds every (date, ticker) combination at once.
.xs drops the selected level; swaplevel reorders for per-ticker work.

code:
weekly = prices.resample("W-FRI").last()
# daily -> weekly, fewer rows

vol20 = (prices.pct_change()
               .rolling(20).std())
# still daily, trailing 20-day window
caption: resample aggregates into coarser buckets; rolling keeps every row.

code:
ts = pd.Timestamp("2025-03-10 09:30")
ny = ts.tz_localize("America/New_York")
ny.tz_convert("Europe/London")

fri = pd.Timestamp("2025-01-03")
fri + BusinessDay(1)  # skips the weekend
caption: Naive vs. aware timestamps can't mix; BusinessDay skips Sat/Sun.
